opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an established independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or not‑for‑profit position, have teaching and admin duties, and be based in the UK. Co‑applicants must be exceptional researchers from a different Academy remit, also UK‑based.
opportunities.summary: Cross‑disciplinary, curiosity‑driven research awards for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary projects across the social sciences, humanities, engineering and natural sciences.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher (early‑career to senior) in the humanities or social sciences, with prior public‑engagement experience; previous award holders cannot reapply.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, supporting up to £8,000 for direct project costs.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Travel, accommodation and visa costs funded for early‑career researchers from the UK or Germany to attend a three‑day interdisciplinary symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or research organisation, who have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and are not in a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships (80 % FEC) for independent research leading to a publishable output, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑resident researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, working in the humanities or social sciences; independent researchers without institutional affiliation are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities, language or other methodological skills; up to £10,000 for 6‑12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based PI from the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral level or above) with an eligible UK institution, must involve overseas co‑applicants and be genuinely interdisciplinary across SHAPE or STEM disciplines.
opportunities.summary: 24‑month awards (80 % FEC) for collaborative international projects on mobilities, up to £300,000 (total project value up to £375,000).

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; no specific disciplinary restriction, must be able to work with DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: Two one‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP, up to £150,000 (80 % FEC), focusing on security, defence, Indo‑European relations, technology/AI, or European strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (exceptionally higher amounts may be considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; must be UK‑based.
opportunities.summary: Rolling‑deadline funding to support specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility support) for award‑holders or applicants.
